name: Remove bloatware & ads
summary: Disables common pre-installed junk and ad/recommendation services. Nothing is deleted — every app is only disabled for the current user and can be re-enabled instantly.
notes: Uses `pm disable-user`, which is fully reversible with `pm enable`.
Package list is conservative. Review it for your box before applying.

steps.label: This recipe only DISABLES apps (reversible). It never uninstalls system software.
Disable the built-in deals/ads app (if present)
